title: GOG confirm they are working towards GOG Galaxy on Linux
excerpt: GOG previously said they planned to look closer at Linux, and that it was the next major frontier - and they're now working towards GOG Galaxy on Linux.
content_html:
GOG previously said they planned to look closer at Linux, and that it was the next major frontier - and they're now working towards GOG Galaxy on Linux.

While GOG do support Linux from the web store, as they offer Linux downloads for games that support Linux, GOG Galaxy itself has been missing since the initial release. Eventually, that should change as we have some positive news to share on that.

Speaking to GOG over email, GamingOnLinux got a response from joint-CEO, Krzysztof Papliński, who said:

"Linux continues to be one of the topics we hear the most about from our community, and we really appreciate the passion and patience of everyone who’s been asking about it.

Following the role we announced earlier this year, we now have the specialist on board and are actively exploring the best way to approach Linux support for GOG GALAXY. This is a significant undertaking, so while we’re not ready to share any specific plans, timelines, or results just yet, it’s very much an area we’re investing time and effort into.

We’re excited about the possibilities and will be happy to share more when the time is right!"

Hopefully it won't take too long.

You can install and manage games from GOG on SteamOS / Linux using our guide - but direct official support is always better.

Article taken from GamingOnLinux.com.

content_html_zh:
GOG 此前表示，他们计划更仔细地研究 Linux，这是下一个主要前沿 - 他们现在正在致力于 Linux 上的 GOG Galaxy。

虽然 GOG 确实通过网络商店支持 Linux，因为他们为支持 Linux 的游戏提供 Linux 下载，但自最初发布以来，GOG Galaxy 本身就一直缺失。 最终，这种情况应该会改变，因为我们有一些积极的消息可以分享。

GamingOnLinux 通过电子邮件接受 GOG 采访，得到了联合首席执行官 Krzysztof Papliński 的回复，他表示：

“Linux 仍然是我们从社区中听到最多的话题之一，我们非常感谢每个询问这个问题的人的热情和耐心。 继我们今年早些时候宣布的角色之后，我们现在聘请了专家，并正在积极探索为 GOG GALAXY 提供 Linux 支持的最佳方法。 这是一项重大任务，因此虽然我们尚未准备好分享任何具体计划、时间表或结果，但这在很大程度上是我们正在投入时间和精力的领域。 我们对这些可能性感到兴奋，并且很乐意在时机成熟时分享更多！”

希望不会花太长时间。

您可以使用我们的指南在 SteamOS / Linux 上安装和管理 GOG 游戏 - 但直接的官方支持总是更好。
